about_short_description.short_description: Degrees of Freedom develops innovative consumer-facing products which draw from the fields of aerospace, origami, and mathematics.

product.name: Kinetacube Ring Box
product.description: A ring box with a patented mobius kaleidocycle mechanism that transforms fluidly to reveal its contents, securing rings with a silk or velvet-wrapped foam insert.

identifier.value: V1 Vixiv Invixiball — Titanium Spherical Lattice

product.name: V1 Vixiv Invixiball — Titanium Spherical Lattice
product.description: A titanium lattice sphere designed as a kinetic toy and mathematical sculpture that compresses and rebounds with a unique tactile and auditory experience.

identifier.value: Kinetic Chess Set - Second Limited Edition

product.name: Kinetic Chess Set - Second Limited Edition
product.description: A chess set featuring heavy, well-built pieces made from premium materials, designed for users who appreciate mechanical craftsmanship in games.

product.name: First Limited Edition Titan Jitterbug
product.description: A titanium and brass fidget toy based on Buckminster Fuller’s Jitterbug mechanism, offering smooth expansion and contraction with a single degree of freedom.

product.name: Kinetacube Display Stand
product.description: A carbon fiber-filled nylon stand designed to hold and showcase Kinetacube Ring Boxes, featuring a rubber base and a tray for daily wear jewelry.

product.name: Kinetacube Remove Before Flight
product.description: A red polyester insert accessory for the Kinetacube Ring Box, inspired by aerospace 'Remove Before Flight' tags, providing a removable cover for the box’s opening.
